title: Training for NATO Level of English Language
descriptions: Training system to achieve NATO L2. It addresses the development of those four skills and tries to improve the training and the results. The study will also revise the comparability of the results before and after the application of the training proposed in this exploratory research and a Comparison of CEF (Common European Framework) and NATO Language Standards.
